svg.aria-label: ESP32-DevKitC V4 and 38-pin clones to CC1101: VCC to 3V3; GND to GND; MOSI to IO23; MISO to IO19; SCK to IO18; CSN to IO5; GDO0 to IO2
svg.title: ESP32-DevKitC V4 and 38-pin clones to CC1101
svg.desc: VCC to 3V3; GND to GND; MOSI to IO23; MISO to IO19; SCK to IO18; CSN to IO5; GDO0 to IO2. GDO2 not connected.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Verdana, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ESP32-DevKitC V4 and 38-pin clones to CC1101

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Verdana, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Top view, antenna end up, USB at the bottom. Go by the labels printed on your board, not by position.

svg.text: VCC goes to 3V3 only, never 5V. The CC1101 is a 3.3 V part.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Verdana, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: GDO0 goes to IO2 (may be printed 2 or G2). The pin marked D2 or SD2 by the USB end is a flash pin, not GPIO 2.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Verdana, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Line colours are only for tracing. Any jumper colour works. GDO2 stays unconnected.
